title: Tofu Larb
description: Tofu Larb is a vibrant Thai Isaan-style salad featuring crispy tofu tossed with toasted rice powder, roasted chili, fresh herbs, and a bold lime-fish sauce dressing. This plant-based version of the classic larb delivers a refreshing combination of spicy, sour, savory, and aromatic flavors with a satisfying contrast of textures.

ingredients.title: For the Tofu & Larb Base
items: Firm tofu – 400 g (14 oz), drained and crumbled
Neutral oil – 2 tbsp (rice bran or grapeseed preferred)
Thai fish sauce – 1½ tbsp (or light soy sauce for vegetarian version)

ingredients.title: For Aromatics & Fresh Herbs
items: Culantro – 1 sprig (optional, for authentic Northeastern aroma)
Coriander leaves (cilantro) – 1 small handful, roughly chopped

ingredients.title: For Garnish & Serving
items: Crisp lettuce or cabbage leaves for wrapping
Long beans or cucumber slices as refreshing sides
Warm sticky rice for traditional serving

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Tofu
steps: Drain tofu thoroughly and crumble it by hand or with a fork into small irregular pieces similar to minced meat.
Heat oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and cook for 6–8 minutes until lightly golden and crisp around the edges.
Remove from heat and keep warm.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Seasoning the Larb
steps: While the tofu is still warm, add toasted rice powder, roasted chili, fish sauce or soy sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar if using.
Mix gently until the tofu is evenly coated.
Adjust seasoning according to taste: add more lime for acidity, fish sauce for saltiness, or chili for extra heat.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Adding Herbs & Aromatics
steps: Fold in sliced shallots, spring onions, coriander, mint, and optional Thai basil or culantro.
Toss gently to keep the herbs fresh and aromatic.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Serving the Tofu Larb
steps: Transfer larb to a chilled bowl or serving platter.
Arrange lettuce leaves, cabbage, cucumber, and other fresh vegetables alongside.
Serve immediately with warm sticky rice for a traditional Thai Isaan-style meal.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve wrapped in crisp lettuce leaves for a refreshing bite.
Pair with warm sticky rice, fresh cabbage, cucumber, and long beans.
Garnish with extra toasted rice powder and fresh herbs for a restaurant-style presentation.

chefTips: Make authentic toasted rice powder by dry-toasting sticky rice until golden and grinding it into a coarse powder for a nutty aroma.
Use roasted chili flakes instead of raw chili powder for deeper flavor and a more balanced heat.
Keep tofu slightly crisp before mixing with herbs to create the ideal texture contrast.
Add fresh herbs at the end and toss lightly to preserve their fragrance.
A great larb should balance spicy, sour, salty, and lightly sweet flavors rather than overpowering heat.
